== [[File:logoecred.png|left|25px]]History ==
[EC] Elite Corps, the oldest polish OFP/ARMA series clan, was founded on 8th of November, 2004. The clan's roots come from ''Edition Center (EC Team)'' and ''WOLF''.

== [[File:logoecred.png|left|25px]]Participated Leagues, Tournaments and Campaigns ==
*PFL (Polish Flashpoint League)
*TNT (Troops, Nukes and Tactics)
*OTFKB (Ogólnopolski Turniej Flashpointa - Kierunek Berlin)
*[[ECL]] (European Combat League)
*CCL (Classic Combat League)
*{{Link|http://www.esl.eu|ESL}} (European Sports League)
*[[IC:ArmA_-_International_Conflict:_Armed_Assault|IC-ARMA]] (International Conflict: Armed Assault)
*{{Link|http://www.arma-tactical-combat.com|ATC}} (ArmA Tactical Combat)
*VB (Virtual Battle)
